Definition: a Tsemarite or branch of the Canaanites
BiblicalUsage: Tsᵉmârîy describes a Tsemarite or branch of the Canaanites. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Genesis 10:18 and 1 Chronicles 1:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tsᵉmârîy belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
